newsitem.title: INDIA: India permits export of 1.0 mln tonnes of sugar.
newsitem.headline: India permits export of 1.0 mln tonnes of sugar.

text.p: The Indian government has authorised the Food Ministry to permit export of 1.0 million tonnes of sugar in the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) sugar season, Commerce Minister B.B. Ramaiah said on Monday.
He told parliament that neighbouring Pakistan had sought 208,000 tonnes of sugar from India in 1996/97 (April-March).

The Indian Sugar and General Industry Export Corporation Limited had received "orders from the Trading Corporation of Pakistan and other private parties for supply of 208,000 tonnes of sugar during the current year," Ramaiah said."
Of this, 120,000 tonnes had been shipped after quality tests by surveyors nominated by Pakistani buyers, he said.
